query_transform_notes: Under the 1,500-char limit. Tavily: keep queries short and send separate searches for multi-topic questions; 'advanced' is for 'multi-faceted questions, or long, detailed queries', so the single question is kept. Variant TAV-S-SPLIT3 (3 focused sub-queries, merged to top 10) pre-registered.

post_steps.why: Best practices: 'For thorough extraction, search first, then pass the URLs to the Extract API.'

cost_model: advanced search 2 credits + advanced extract 2 credits per 5 successful URLs (3 URLs) = up to 4 credits; $0.005-$0.008/credit by plan (PAYG $0.008) = $0.020-$0.032. usage.credits is authoritative.

session_id.note: Named in Search Best Practices (session tracking) but not shown in the /search API reference table read on 2026-11-11. Drop it if the API rejects it.

max_results.note: API reference says default 10 (0-20); the best-practices page says default 5. We pin 10 explicitly, so the conflict does not matter.

rationale.search_depth: 'advanced': highest relevance, for niche topics and multi-faceted questions.
rationale.chunks_per_source: Max (3): more query-relevant text per source for the extractor.
rationale.auto_parameters: Off: explicit params are frozen; auto may silently upgrade cost.
rationale.include_answer: Off for the search arm: the fixed extractor reads content, not a vendor answer.
rationale.include_raw_content: Off: docs prescribe Extract for thorough reading; post-step fetches top 3.
